nar.text: The cloudless morning was beautiful with a light fresh breeze.
The cars started individually in order of their race numbers at intervals of four minutes beginning at 7:00 in the morning.
The four large Peugeots started without problems and rushed into the lead while the Bugattis took off at a slower pace.

The four large Peugeots started without problems and rushed into the lead while the Bugattis took off at a slower pace.
On the stretch to Polizzi, the highest point of the course, Wagner dropped one minute behind Boillot. Costantinis gap behind Wagner increased to two minutes.
Boillot maintained his fast pace to Cerda, closely followed by Wagner and Dauvergne in third place.
Boillot's first lap sets a new lap record: 1h28m44s, 73.027 km/h.

Pierre de Vizcaya stopped at the pits to change both rear tires. Ten or more enthusiastic spectators helped him which explains why he could leave after only 1m26s whilst remaining in his seat.
Fernando de Vizcaya stopped at the pits for a few minutes. His car had a damaged crankcase
Boillot was hindered by tire trouble which enabled Wagner to get first place.
On the last stretch to Cerda, Dauvergne gained slightly on Boillot which put him in second position.
Rigal lost much time against Costantini who had increased his pace.

Shortly after Cerda at KM 13, he took a not particularly difficult wide bend too fast and the car overturned and caught fire.
Wagner came by at this time and stopped to give help, Christian Dauvergne was freed in a horribly burned condition
Wagner stopped at all the control stations to report the accident and as a result lost much time.
Between Polizzi and Cerda Costantini took the lead and at the end of the lap was three minutes ahead of the two Peugeots.

At the beginning of the fourth lap, Rigal took a wrong road at Cerda, in fact at KM 9, where he crashed at full speed into a barrier. The Peugeot caught fire and was out of the race.
The driver escaped without injuries but the mechanic suffered burns.

Boillot and Costantini were now in a heated battle and Wagner also tried once more to make up lost ground.
On the next stretch to Collesano Wagner actually succeeded in beating Boillot with a time of 7h19m while Boillot showed up with just 7h21m.
Costantini crossed the finish line five minutes ahead of Wagner and completed the last lap in 1h28m37s at an average speed of 73.067 km/h, having beaten Boillot's record from the first lap.
